title: Bar Salts Banana Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Vampire Vape
description: Taste a tropical paradise with every puff of Banana Ice from Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts collection, an e-liquid that stands as a mouth-watering testament to the power of simple, natural flavours. When you inhale, it's as if you're biting into a perfectly ripe banana—a luxurious blend of sweetness, silkiness, and the slightest hint of tropical sunshine. But wait, there's a twist! An icy undercurrent soon follows, turning what was a tropical reverie into an exhilarating experience. The cooling sensation perfectly offsets the banana's natural sweetness, resulting in a vape that's as balanced as it is imaginative. Each puff is a narrative, a story of opposites in harmony, taking you on a journey that's both comforting and adventurous. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production, and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. These Vampire Vape nic salt e-liquids are perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts along with a super-smooth throat hit. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. If you love the delicious flavours found in the most popular disposable vape bars, then you’ll love Vampire Vape’s new Bar Salts collection of 10ml nic-salt e-liquids. Inspired by the tastiest disposable vape bar flavours, the collection includes classics like Watermelon, Grape, and Strawberry Ice, as well as more unique blends such as Kiwi Passionfruit Guava and Pink Lemonade. These 10ml e-liquids can be used in starter kits and pod kits and they allow you to enjoy your favourite flavours for far longer than a 2ml disposable vape device, all while reducing plastic waste. And because they share the same nicotine salt formulation as their disposable cousins, Vampire Vape Bar Salts deliver all the satisfying relief from nicotine cravings along with a super-smooth throat hit for comfortable, effective and enjoyable all-day vaping.
